E) NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
REF(A) TURKISH WARNING NOTAM A2144/26
REF(B) GREEK WARNING NOTAM A1639/26
 THE VIEWS EXPRESSED IN TURKISH NAVIGATIONAL WARNING NOTAM IN REF(A) 
WITH RESPECT TO TURKISH FIRING EXERCISE WITHIN INTERNATIONAL WATERS 
AND AIRSPACE REMAIN UNCHANGED AND THE NOTAM IN REF(A) IS VALID AND 
EFFECTIVE. THE GREEK WARNING NOTAM IN REF(B) IS 
NULL AND VOID.

 TURKIYE ALSO WOULD LIKE TO EMPHASIZE THAT NO FURTHER EXPLANATION 
WILL BE GIVEN TO ANY OBJECTION RAISED TO TURKISH NOTAM IN REF(A).
